name: Image Studio
title: Image Studio by Shifros — WebP Converter, Resize & Crop
description: Convert images to WebP, JPG or PNG, then resize, crop and compress them in your browser. Free, no sign-up, and nothing is uploaded.

faq.q: How do I convert an image to WebP?
faq.a: Add your images, choose WebP under Batch settings, set the quality and press Download. Up to 20 images download as one ZIP.

faq.q: Are my images uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. Image Studio converts and edits images inside your browser. Files never leave your device and are cleared when you close the tab.
Input: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, SVG, BMP and AVIF. Output: WebP, JPG and PNG.

faq.q: Can I resize or crop an image to an exact size?
faq.a: Yes. Press Edit on an image and type the width and height, for example 500 × 600. The crop box locks to that shape; move it to choose the area, and the export is exactly that size.

faq.q: Can each image have its own settings?
faq.a: Yes. Batch settings apply to every image, and Edit gives one image its own format, quality, size, crop, rotation and flip.

faq.q: What quality should I use for WebP?
faq.a: 75 to 85 suits most photos and keeps files small. Use 90 or higher for detailed artwork, or PNG when you need lossless output.
Yes. There is no account and no watermark. Limits: 20 images at a time, 50 MB each, up to 64 megapixels and 16,384 pixels per side.
